summary: Implemented foreground single-run coordinator reusing lock, IPC, store and runtime MessageService/SessionCoordinator. assign/send/inbox/ack/reply/stop and reconcile/resume now use IPC without CLI direct-write fallback. Current actor/generation and durable message/ACK/stop idempotency gates preserved.
tests: Single owner and subprocess contention; IPC forwarding; 12 concurrent identical requests; ACK/reply/stop and assignment reopen stability; identity/current-generation/shared-namespace rejection; atomic stop-receipt rollback; no-coordinator/dead-socket/wrong-run no-fallback; strict params; graceful cleanup.
remaining: Existing migrated run/seats required. Native reset/submit adapters absent; assignments queue with structured UNIMPLEMENTED reasons. Capability PARTIAL and native communication UNVERIFIED; stop records intent only with PROCESS_STOP_UNIMPLEMENTED. No real multi-pane up, Claude, automatic recovery or process-level attach/stop.
constraints: Only agentflow project changed; tested window/workspace/surfaces were not accessed. No new dependency, daemon, service framework or native field action.
next: Main reviews coordinator/CLI/store implementation and local evidence; independently scope native adapter and full-team lifecycle work. Queue acceptance is not main acceptance ACK.
